notes.title: Dying Flame First Major Update v1.0.5
notes.notes:
We've heard your feedback, and we've improved upon it! We thank you all for helping us improve Dying Flame even further.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1507950/Dying_Flame/

Update log:
- Minor grammar and text errors
- Minor bugs and glitches fixed
- Floor holes relocation
- Walking past a hole now pauses you for half a second (maybe you won't fall into holes instantly anymore)
- Gave more feedback on puzzle completion
- Gave clearer instructions on where to go and what to do next
- Improved upon some dialogue and journal entries

Keep those feedback coming!
If you have any problems, please use community hub to reach out to us: HERE
Or you can always join us in discord: HERE

Have fun and keep that flame going!
RoundTable Games Studios
